qa_pair.question: An agent submitted four frames for lt_seed_broker. In the frame idle_south_1, how many pixels have the outline colour ink_01? Answer with the number only.

The frame idle_south_3 of lt_seed_broker was edited after it was submitted. In its newest version, exactly one pixel has a colour that no other pixel in the frame has. Which palette id is that colour, and at which x,y (x across, y down, from the top left, counting from 0) is the pixel? Answer as "palette_id x,y", for example "ink_01 3,4".
